title: 2.3.31 Challenges: Stretch Problems
description: Stretch problems. Every challenge is required to continue. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed: stretch practice synthesizing switch, grouped cases, and fall-through debugging

steps.title: HTTP Status Advisor
steps.instructions: Write a switch on a variable code. 200 prints OK, 404 prints Not Found, 500 prints Server Error, and default prints Unknown status.

steps.title: Season from Month
steps.instructions: Write a switch on a variable month (a number 1-12) that groups months into four seasons using grouped cases, then prints the season.

steps.title: Find the Fall-Through
steps.instructions: content.md gives you a broken three-case switch that prints too much. Find and fix the missing break without changing anything else.

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote JavaScript for the lab "2.3.31 Challenges: Stretch Problems". The task they were given: Write a switch on a variable code. 200 prints OK, 404 prints Not Found, 500 prints Server Error, and default prints Unknown status. You cannot run their code: read it and judge what it WOULD do. Judge each criterion by whether the idea is achieved, however the student wrote it. Different variable and function names, template strings, arrow functions, semicolons, spacing, quotes and order are all fine. Do not require any particular structure unless the criterion names one. Mark a criterion missing only when the idea is absent or the code does the opposite. Code inside a comment never runs. Write each note for THIS student's own code: in a not-met note, name the exact line or name in their code that causes the problem (quote at most a few words of it), say in plain words what it does now versus what the criterion needs, and give one concrete next thing to try, but do NOT write the corrected code. In a met note, say in one short phrase what in their code satisfied it. Do not use generic praise.
